captions.detailed: This 3D model represents the outside half of a two-part interlocking bag clip. It features a long, smooth, curved ribbon-like body with a uniform width. On one end, there is a circular C-shaped hinge receiver with a gap in the center, designed to snap over a matching pin. On the opposite end, it terminates in a small, curved clasp hook that secures the two halves together when closed.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric bag clip in OpenSCAD that can generate either the 'Inside' or 'Outside' interlocking parts. The script should allow customization of the overall length, width, curvature, and wall thicknesses, as well as hinge tolerances and an optional embossed or engraved text label on the outer spine.
captions.factory: The code uses a custom 'roundArc' module built from subtracted cylinders ('smallArc') to create the curved main body and circular ends. The 'outerClip' module combines this main arc with a C-shaped hinge arc on one end and a smaller clasp hook on the other, utilizing 'difference' to cut out the central hinge slot. The 'innerClip' module creates the mating half with a central cylindrical hinge pin connected to the main body using a 'hull' loop.
